rules.source: Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering art. 475b-475e; Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet (2021)
rules.statement: A court/deurwaarder-ordered wage garnishment (loonbeslag) deducted from an employee's net pay shall never push that net pay below the employee's beslagvrije voet (the protected minimum): deduction = min(orderedAmount, max(0, nettoPay - beslagvrijeVoet)).

rules.source: hrmq loonbeslag MVP scope (design.md D4) -- BW art. 475d governs priority ordering across simultaneous garnishments, not yet implemented
rules.statement: Until priority/preferente-vordering ordering across simultaneous garnishments is implemented, an employer's payroll administration shall carry at most one actief Loonbeslag per employee per effective period.
